source_kind: Built-in imagegen authored central crop; this is the deterministic rebuild entry point, not a claim that imagegen can be regenerated deterministically.
alpha_application: Native ImageMagick CopyOpacity applied the approved seven-logical-pixel source-layout alpha. Every authored RGB byte, including hidden RGB, is unchanged at this stage. The mask is baked into the included RGBA; no separate original mask is included.
master_disposition: The full master and contextual reference images remain in the author workspace outside this package. Only the generated central tile is distributed.
frozen_constraints: Six accepted generated HD neighbor perimeters are included as RGB-only numeric constraints with immutable accepted HDA/RGBA provenance hashes; original-game raster data is not included.
